display.summary: Long work leaves web's request threads. Outbound mail (2FA codes, password resets, registration and notification emails) is queued on the task worker with its own express lane, and each notification recipient gets their own message. Export Entries and Reset data run as background jobs that show their progress; the weather city search, the OCR file hash and the Options API status check run on the worker, and backup chain downloads stream. Pages are lighter: the System Settings editors, the guided tour and PDF.js load only where they are used and framework scripts are deferred, so a sign-in page drops from about 1.9 MB to 1.4 MB. Searchable selectors show their search placeholder in the UI language. Web and worker update inline from any 1.16 release; migration 0031 adds the background-jobs table.
highlights: Outbound mail is queued on the task worker, so a slow mail server no longer holds a web request.
Each notification email goes to one recipient, so no one sees the others' addresses.
Export Entries and Reset data run in the background and show their progress.
Weather city search, the OCR file hash and the Options API status check run on the worker.
Settings editors, the guided tour and PDF.js load only where used: a sign-in page drops from 1.9 MB to 1.4 MB.
Backup chain downloads stream as they are built instead of waiting for a temporary ZIP.
Searchable selectors show their search placeholder in the UI language.
Web and worker update inline from any 1.16 release; migration 0031 adds the background-jobs table.
